source.directorySummary: Manages the file tree subcommand: parsing depth/target/ext/expanded/reveal arguments, resolving and validating the workspace target, building filtered text trees and lazily-expandable web directory listings with IGNORE/.gitignore filtering, and decorating rows with aggregated git status for CLI and web surfaces.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Bridges parsed CLI invocations to web or text execution via parseTreeTokensFromParsed, renderTreeForWeb (parseTreeCliArgs + listWorkspaceDirectoryEntries + renderFileTreeBrowserWeb) and adaptTreeCommand dispatch to handleTreeCommand.

cli.ts.sourceSummary: Standalone CLI entry that strips --appweaver-workspace flag, shows help, parses maxDepth/target/ext via parseTreeCliArgs, and prints buildWorkspaceTree from cwd or AppWeaver workspace root.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Declares the tree SubcommandDefinition with variadic rest argument, ext/expanded/reveal options, examples, and header webWidget singleton configuration.

git-status.ts.sourceSummary: Collects git decorations via git status --porcelain -z, parses nul-delimited entries into kind/priority, and bubbles file statuses to ancestor directories except deleted/renamed.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Handles non-web tree requests by merging restTokens/extOption through parseTreeCliArgs and returning buildWorkspaceTree text or a formatted error.

workspace-tree.ts.sourceSummary: Core tree utilities that parse CLI args, enforce workspace-contained resolution, filter by IGNORE/IGNORE_EXT/.gitignore, and build text trees or expandable web rows with git decorations.

summary.value: plugins/file/commands/tree implements the file `tree` subcommand — parsing depth/target/ext/expanded/reveal args, resolving/validating the workspace target, and building IGNORE/.gitignore-filtered text trees and lazily-expandable web directory listings decorated with aggregated git status for CLI and web. Child renderers/ (complete) provides web rendering via stylesheet, icons, and interactive WebNode tree with navigation, expand/collapse, and file operations.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Read-only discovery surface within the plugins/file/commands aggregation — the browsing counterpart to mutating file/git commands. Provides the foundational navigation layer that view/edit/create/delete/rename operate inside, bridging the centralized adapter/handleFile dispatch to both CLI and lazy web execution paths. Owns its own git-status bubbling and delegates interactive expansion/navigation/file-ops UI to the renderers/ child, while reusing shared/ workspace containment and IGNORE/.gitignore filtering shared with sibling file commands.

files.adapter.ts: Dual-surface dispatch bridge for this subcommand — routes already-parsed invocations from the file plugin's centralized dispatcher to either web rendering (parseTreeCliArgs + listWorkspaceDirectoryEntries + renderFileTreeBrowserWeb) or text execution (adaptTreeCommand/handleTreeCommand); owns no tree-building logic itself.
files.cli.ts: Standalone out-of-process entry point that bypasses plugin registration — strips --appweaver-workspace, parses args from cwd/workspace root, and directly prints buildWorkspaceTree text; provides direct CLI invocation path reusing the same core engine as the plugin-embedded flow.
files.definition.ts: Contract declaration for the tree subcommand within the 20-command registry — defines variadic rest arg, ext/expanded/reveal options, examples, and header webWidget singleton that signals the dispatcher to instantiate the interactive web tree surface.
files.git-status.ts: Isolated decoration provider for the tree — parses git status --porcelain -z into prioritized kinds and bubbles child statuses to ancestors (excluding deleted/renamed); consumed by workspace-tree to annotate both text and web rows without coupling core filtering/tree logic to git.
files.handler.ts: Text-surface counterpart to adapter's web path — thin orchestration that merges restTokens/extOption via parseTreeCliArgs and returns buildWorkspaceTree text or formatted error for CLI/non-web callers.
files.workspace-tree.ts: Central engine of the subcommand — owns CLI arg parsing, workspace-contained resolution, IGNORE/IGNORE_EXT/.gitignore filtering, and construction of both text trees and expandable web rows with git decorations; depended on by adapter, cli, and handler as the single source of tree semantics.
